record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 QwT adds a small linear structure to quantized networks and solves the calibration/accuracy adjustment in closed form in under two minutes. It evaluates vision, language and multimodal tasks; the paper motivates compression/acceleration but the reviewed results do not demonstrate a specific LLM serving latency or throughput gain.
